blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C1):** eu consigo usar hold e seus sentidos (hold talks, hold firm, hold out, hold off, hold back, hold sway) numa resenha de livro.

body: Esta aula treina **escrever frases claras e corretas (IELTS Writing, TOEFL Writing)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.title: Review: “Hold Your Ground”
paras: In this lively guide to bargaining, the author argues that negotiators who **hold firm** on principles but stay flexible on details tend to win more. She **holds** that patience pays: delegations that **hold out** for a better term often get it, while those that **hold back** information lose trust.
Her case studies are gripping, although a few sections **hold up** less well. Still, the book **holds the reader’s attention** to the last page. Four stars.

items.q: The author says flexibility on details is useless.
Delegations that hold out sometimes get better terms.
The reviewer finds every section strong.
items.why: a few sections hold up less well.

opts: resistir à espera de algo melhor

head: Expressão
Sentido
Exemplo
rows: They **held out for** a better deal.
hold off / hold back / hold sway
Prices **held off**; he **held back** the figures.

blocks.body: **hold** vai de “segurar” a “realizar”, “considerar” e “resistir”. Aprenda por **combinações**, não por tradução única.

items.s: The two sides will ___ talks in May. (hold)
The union decided to ___ out for a better offer. (hold)
She ___ firm on her principles. (hold, past)
The report says prices will ___ steady. (hold)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

items.ans: What does she say about patience
items.pt: O que ela diz sobre paciência?

items.ans: Did the author hold your attention

body: **Hold all the aces.** — Ter todas as vantagens.
**Did the author hold your attention?** — A autora prendeu sua atenção?
**What does she say about patience?** — O que ela diz sobre paciência?
**Mostly, though a few chapters don’t hold up.** — Quase sempre, embora alguns capítulos não se sustentem.

blocks.task: Write a 5-sentence review of a book, film or course using hold in different senses.
blocks.model: This guide to negotiation holds the reader’s attention. The author holds that patience pays, and her stories show teams that held out for a better deal. A few chapters do not hold up, and she holds back some data. Still, I recommend it. Three and a half stars.

items.why: **hold out for** = resistir à espera de.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
